description_en: Renames a specified data source. This is a lightweight operation

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. You can pass this parameter explicitly by using --tenant-id in winnexo-cli

parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The data source ID, which is unique within the tenant
parameters.help_zh: 数据源 ID（租户内唯一）

parameters.help_en: The new name of the data source
parameters.name: new_name
